take: As the Sharks announced, San Jose recalled D Libor Hajek and F Filip Bystedt from the AHL, assigned D Luca Cagnoni to the AHL, and placed Igor Chernyshov and Alexander Wennberg on injured reserve. We have no numbers on Hajek or Bystedt. Cagnoni's team had a 38.6% share of the 5-on-5 chance quality while he played, and San Jose's share was 4.2 points better with him off the ice. In games already played without them, Collin Graf has stepped into both forward spots, and Ivar Stenberg's ice time has risen to 18:43 a night from 15:45.
